message:
fix(apk): a key request is published with its causes and consumed with them in one section; a cancelled one is never sent as legacy; the held check returns only its own snapshot; the owed duty's spent asks are told to the sink (keepalive-r2 e, apk-decoder-inbox C r2, Codex codex_apk_inbox_c_src_r1.md N2 and §8 (a))

N2 (Codex: a new pick + owner change between NextAction and the ledger take -> the action went out as a legacy
request with no descriptor; the RX publish and the held snapshot had the same kind of gap):
- RequestKey: the limiter's Request and the descriptor's merge in ONE section of keyLedgerMu_ (every request path:
  RX, the select answer, owed, the sink's own wants, the assembler's pipeline ask -- no Request() outside it).
- the scheduler's NextAction (which consumes the limiter's pending flag) and the take of the accepted descriptor in
  ONE section (parkMu_ -> keyLedgerMu_; local work only, no sink call, no network).
- ClearKeyLedger (a new pick / reset) consumes the limiter's pending flag with the descriptors; a KeyframeRequest action
  with no descriptor is CANCELLED -- not sent, counted (KeyRequestsDroppedCancelled); never read as a legacy request.
  Legacy / pipeline requests always carry their own cause.
- the held check: the snapshot and its version; the sink is asked with no lock held; under the lock only that same
  snapshot is acted on -- a request held meanwhile stays, whole, for the next pass.
§8 (a) (Codex: owed's 8 limiter-taken asks are the cap; no new episode budget after them):
- the session tells the sink once the 8th owed ask has left or been dropped (OnDecoderKeyOwedExhausted, the duty's
  token; a defaulted virtual + the binding adapter). Counted as limiter-QUEUED asks, not "8 on the wire".
- the sink: a stale token changes nothing (coveredStale); the current one -> covered (no asks of its own: owed is the
  same IDR), a final window of 4 s, then -- with no usable IDR preserved -- coveredExhausted (an open episode with it:
  KeyRecoveryEpisode::MarkExhausted). The gate is never paid by this; a late IDR is fed, pays the duty and ends it;
  a re-arm / reset / new surface ends it. DebugStatus: covered coveredExh coveredStale.

Tests:
- android_decoder_inbox_session_test 22/22 (product session + loopback fake host): + [S2] the accepted point also with
  a new pick; + [S5] a pick + owner change right before the dequeue of a published request -> nothing reaches the
  host; + [S6] a new valid (pipeline) request held while the held check asks the sink is not erased: it goes once the
  limiter allows; + [S7] the owner changes inside the publish -> judged stale, not sent; + [S8] the selection's IDR
  lost (held, then the codec reset): the host gets the 8 owed asks, the sink goes covered, then covered-exhausted with
  NO further request; the host's late IDR is decoded and ends it.
- android_decoder_inbox_c_test 40/40: + [C11] stale notice ignored; covered with no own ask; exhausted after the 4 s
  window with the gate still owing; the late IDR fed and paying; a new surface re-arms and ends the covered state.
- whole tree builds (0 errors); regressions as before (pure 51, inbox 12, owed_key 32, geometry 10, binding 17,
  decode_stats 42, liveness 68, session_liveness 9, pending_slot 21, prelogin_select 60, idr_recovery 49).
Negative runs against 5fe90a9 / mutants follow. No device run.
